name: Kallow Fleece Jogger
description: Standard mid-weight fleece jogger with a drawstring waist, ribbed cuffs, and two side pockets. Comes in heather grey, black, and navy. Soft on the inside, pilled on the outside after a few washes — exactly what you'd expect. Ubiquitous in M88's Tier 2 residential blocks.
what_it_says: You're off the clock, or you never really had a clock to begin with. Comfortable and completely unpretentious.
worn_by: anyone running errands in the block
story_hooks: The same model is sold under six different brand names — all from the same Goretek subsidiary factory.
A character recognizes someone from their old block purely from the distinctive faded logo on these joggers.
